privacy.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: NorthForge Tools collects enquiry details, quotation requests, and document request information only for business response, sales follow-up, and customer support purposes.
Submitted information may include your name, company, email, phone number, country, and product interest. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
Information is retained only as long as needed for commercial communication, compliance, and recordkeeping. You may request correction or deletion by contacting sales@northforgetools.com.

paragraphs: This website is provided for product presentation, business enquiry, RFQ intake, and technical document access related to NorthForge Tools.
Specifications, availability, lead times, and pricing shown on the website are illustrative unless otherwise confirmed in a written quotation or sales agreement.
Use of this website does not create a supply contract. Final terms are governed by issued quotations, purchase orders, and mutually agreed commercial terms.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
paragraphs: NorthForge Tools uses essential website cookies and limited analytics storage to support navigation, form submissions, and basic performance measurement.
Cookies may be used to remember UI state, support request flows, and understand page usage trends. They are not used to sell behavioral data to third parties.
You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling some cookies may affect site functionality such as form persistence or gated downloads.

certifications.title: Quality & Certifications
certifications.description: This section is intended for buyers who need to verify how NorthForge handles quality workflow, material compliance, and document support during export execution.
certifications.overviewDescription: Buyers frequently ask which documents are available, when, and under what conditions. Below is a practical summary.

items.detail: Facility-level certifications (e.g. ISO 9001) are available as PDF copy upon request and can be included in your order documentation package.
RoHS declarations, REACH statements, material test reports, and CE support documents are generated per SKU or product family based on destination market.
Packing lists, carton marks, barcode accuracy control, and certificate-of-origin coordination are part of the standard export program.

certifications.availabilityNote: Document scope varies by product family and destination market.

metadata.title: About NorthForge Tools | OEM Hand Tool Manufacturer in Taiwan
metadata.description: Learn about NorthForge Tools, a Taiwan-based OEM/ODM hand tool manufacturer focused on quality control, export-ready execution, and private-label tool programs.

about.heroDescription: Built for buyers who need more than a supplier. NorthForge supports professional hand tool programs with stronger process control, private-label readiness, and dependable communication.
about.storyTitle: Built for Buyers Who Need More Than a Factory
about.productLinesTitle: Professional Tool Lines for Repeat Programs
about.ctaDescription: If you are building a professional hand tool line, a service-tool assortment, or a private-label toolkit program, NorthForge can help structure a cleaner sourcing workflow from product selection to shipment execution.

productLines.title: Torque Tools
productLines.desc: Torque wrenches, torque screwdrivers, torque multipliers, and beam-type torque tools for precision fastening in automotive, industrial, and utility programs.

productLines.title: Insulated Tools
productLines.desc: VDE-rated hand tools for live-line electrical work, utility maintenance, and installation programs requiring IEC 60900 compliance and color-coded safety identification.

productLines.title: Workshop & Hand Tools
productLines.desc: Ratchets, sockets, spanners, pliers, screwdrivers, and hex keys for professional workshop programs, maintenance kits, and mixed-SKU distributor assortments.

productLines.title: Custom Tool Programs
productLines.desc: Private-label toolkit builds, branded service assortments, drawer-set configurations, and OEM programs requiring documentation, packaging, and specification alignment.

timeline.event: Founded with a focus on OEM torque and hand tool manufacturing for export markets
ISO 9001 certification achieved; formalized quality management for repeat-order programs
Insulated tool line launched with VDE-aligned process controls for utility and electrical channels
Expanded private-label packaging capability including molded cases, barcode labeling, and insert cards
Mixed-SKU kit assembly and drawer-set program capability introduced for distributor channels
Export documentation workflow upgraded to support multi-market compliance and third-party inspection coordination

operationalStrengths.title: Repeat-Order Consistency
operationalStrengths.desc: Drawing control, packaging verification, and QC checkpoint alignment are maintained across production runs to reduce variance between approved sample and delivered product.

operationalStrengths.title: Private-Label and OEM Execution
operationalStrengths.desc: Logo marking, insert cards, molded cases, barcode labels, and retail-ready carton programs are supported as a standard part of program setup, not an add-on.

operationalStrengths.title: Compliance and Documentation Support
operationalStrengths.desc: ISO 9001 workflow, RoHS and REACH documentation, CE support files, and third-party inspection coordination are available to buyers with destination-market requirements.

operationalStrengths.title: Mixed-SKU and Kit Assembly
operationalStrengths.desc: Toolkit builds, drawer-set configurations, and branded assortment programs are supported without enterprise-level complexity, making NorthForge practical for mid-size distributor channels.

storyParagraphs: NorthForge was founded to serve buyers who need more from a supplier than the tool itself — consistent production quality, reliable documentation, and a packaging workflow that doesn't fall apart when the order scales.

Most of our early programs were built around torque tools and insulated hand tools for export markets with demanding specifications. Over time, we expanded to support private-label programs, mixed-SKU toolkit builds, and drawer-set assortments as buyer expectations grew.

We built our operational processes around the premise that the things buyers actually rely on — repeat-order predictability, accurate packing lists, and clean compliance paperwork — are not optional extras. They are the program.
